rubric_hint.rule: 5 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: The notification is a 9.5 ha regeneration felling in Hagfors (polygon 10.32 ha). Completed felling overlaps 0.9% of the polygon (felled 2006).
There are no species records inside the polygon or within 250 m. Near-site effort there is also zero records, and the county median is 0, so this absence says little.

Five eligible site-bound VU fungi are recorded 319-988 m away: Hydnellum scabrosum (319 m, 2025), Tricholoma sudum, Albatrellus subrubescens, Tricholma colossus and Tricholoma matsutake. Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of old/large trees and ground disturbance from forestry. This places them in the 250-1000 m ring, so the rubric gives MEDIUM.
Effort in the 1000 m ring is adequate (75 records, 86th percentile). Nine site-bound forest NT species are recorded within 1000 m, none within 250 m.

uncertainties: The eligible records are at least 319 m from the polygon edge. Whether similar habitat extends into the polygon is unknown.
Several records have small coordinate uncertainty (10-25 m), so their positions are fairly precise. Fungal fruiting records do not show where the mycelium lies.
There is no recording inside or within 250 m of the site, so the absence of near-site records is uninformative.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
That the site is free of threatened species. Absence of records is not absence of species.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the Hydnellum scabrosum records at 319 m extends into the polygon. They should consider a field survey of fungi before felling starts.
